field.label: Webhook URL
field.help: Called when a tunnel is still down after the number of consecutive reconnect attempts set below. Any HTTP(S) endpoint works - point it at a Slack/Discord incoming webhook, PagerDuty, your own receiver, etc. Leave blank to disable notifications for any tunnel that doesn't set its own webhook URL below.

field.label: Notify after this many failed attempts
field.help: Consecutive reconnect attempts (not minutes) a tunnel must fail before the webhook fires. Resets once the tunnel comes back up, so it can fire again on a future outage.

field.label: Webhook signing secret (optional)
field.help: If set, every webhook request includes an X-Watchdog-Signature header (hex-encoded HMAC-SHA256 of the request body, using this secret) so a receiver can verify it actually came from this plugin.
